description: This file contains Drupal theme hook implementations for search results, including theme suggestions, preprocessing of search result variables, and block template preprocessing.

classes.name: SearchThemeHooks
classes.description: Provides theme hook implementations for search, including theme suggestions and preprocessing functions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting language manager and date formatter services.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme hook for search results with variables and preprocess callback.

methods.name: preprocessSearchResult
methods.description: Prepares variables for individual search result templates, including URL, title, language attributes, and meta info.

methods.name: themeSuggestionsSearchResult
methods.description: Provides theme suggestions based on plugin ID for search results.

methods.name: preprocessBlock
methods.description: Preprocesses block templates, setting role attribute for search form block.
